summary: Installers retain a digest-bound .fractal-install.json ownership receipt beside fractal, so upgrades recognize the installation without relying on compatibility aliases.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No database schema changes; a new schema-1 installer ownership file is written beside the executable.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rules change.

compatibility.detail: Existing alias layouts remain accepted. A valid receipt independently proves ownership; an invalid or symlinked receipt fails closed even when aliases remain. Identical unmanaged bytes are not adopted. Version JSON adds a commit field without changing machine_version.

manual.detail: Keep .fractal-install.json with its executable. Restore a matching executable and receipt together if an upgrade reports a mismatched receipt, then reinstall through the original installer.

recovery.detail: Installer rollback restores the prior executable and ownership receipt together. Compatibility aliases remain unchanged.
